content: chrome.runtime.MessageSender exposes tab, frameId, and documentId (Chrome); Firefox's runtime.MessageSender additionally requests origin support was tracked separately (Bugzilla 1787379) and historically lacked frameId (Bugzilla 1354337, since fixed). MessageSender does not label sender type explicitly (page vs content script vs extension) which Chrome's own docs flag as a security footgun -- background code must independently check sender.id === browser.runtime.id and sender.tab/frameId rather than trusting payload-declared origin fields.
